d:
After trailing by as many as 19 points, Georgia mounted an INCREDIBLE comeback against Italy at EuroBasket 2017!
Michael Dixon went OFF, leading the charge with 29 POINTS as Georgia erased the deficit and even took the lead with a HUGE 19-3 run!
But Italy had one last answer. Gigi Datome came up with a CLUTCH block in the final second to preserve a dramatic 71-69 victory!
Georgia came SO CLOSE to completing the comeback. What a CRAZY finish!
